primary_criterion: incremental quality and capability uplift over 14B dense control
canonical_suite_policy: reuse the same 20 intended-local cases unchanged; do not alter prompts or criteria
challenge_suite_policy: up to five predeclared CHALLENGE_ONLY cases run on both 14B and Qwen3; not counted in canonical 20-case score
decision_rule: Qwen3 does not win because it is larger, newer, sparse, or has more total parameters. It must show enough incremental capability over the 14B 17/20 baseline to justify RAM, latency and operational complexity.
